privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Kitchen is a small, invite-only kitchen assistant for one household. This page says what it keeps, who can see it, and how to take it with you or delete it.

sections.heading: What Kitchen stores
sections.body: Your name and the details that keep you signed in. Your kitchen: what you add, use, freeze or run out of, kept as a history of changes with who made each one and when. Your chats with Kitchen. The allergies, diets and preferences saved for you. Meal ideas, recipes, meal plans and shopping lists.

sections.heading: Who can see it
sections.body: Everyone in your kitchen sees the kitchen, its history (including who made each change), the shopping list, the meal plan, and each member's allergies and diets, so meals stay safe for everyone. Your chats are private: other members never see them.

sections.heading: AI processing
sections.body: To understand your messages and suggest meals, Kitchen sends what you type, the relevant parts of your kitchen, and your kitchen members' allergies and diets to Anthropic, which runs the Claude AI model that writes the replies. Anthropic handles it under its own commercial terms and privacy policy.

sections.heading: Where it's kept
sections.body: The app runs on Vercel and the data is kept in a Neon database. Your phone also keeps a few small things for convenience, like the widget you used last and shopping ticks that haven't been sent yet. One cookie keeps you signed in. There's no advertising and no tracking.

sections.heading: Taking it with you, or deleting it
sections.body: In Settings, Download my data gives you one file with your account, chats, kitchen changes and profile. Delete my data removes your account, your chats and your profile. Things you added to a shared kitchen stay, credited to "a former member". A kitchen is deleted only when its last member deletes their data.

sections.heading: Never sold
sections.body: Your data is never sold, rented or used for ads. It's shared only with the services that run the app (named above), and only so the app can work.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.body: Ask the person who invited you to Kitchen.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: Kitchen is an early, invite-only test for one household. By using it you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: Not advice
sections.body: Meal ideas, recipes and allergy flags are helpers, not medical, nutrition or food-safety advice, and an AI can get things wrong. Always check ingredients, labels and food safety yourself, especially when someone has an allergy.

sections.heading: Your content
sections.body: What you type stays yours. You let Kitchen store and process it so the app can work, including sending it to Anthropic for the AI replies (see the privacy policy).

sections.heading: A shared kitchen
sections.body: What you add to a shared kitchen is visible to its members. You can save another member's allergy for them; it stays marked as added by you until they confirm it, and only they can change or remove it.

sections.heading: Your access
sections.body: Keep your access code to yourself. If you think someone else has it, use Sign out everywhere in Settings and ask for a new code.

sections.heading: As is
sections.body: This is a test version. It may have bugs, change, or stop, and data could be lost. If something matters to you, download your data from Settings.

sections.heading: Leaving
sections.body: You can stop at any time and delete your data from Settings.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: These terms may change as the app grows. If they do, the app will say so.
